dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge following a parabolic spline with a prominent V-shaped notch located approximately 5% below the distal apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute shape classification with a small pixel radius, truncated by a terminal notch and localized depigmentation.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 50-degree incline relative to the horizontal body axis, characterized by a straight linear margin before the apical curve.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: High verticality with an estimated height-to-base ratio of 1.4:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Moderate convexity with a uniform curvature transitioning from the blowhole region to the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, stubby projection with a low length-to-girth ratio, exhibiting a blunt distal termination.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow obtuse angle of approximately 155 degrees at the junction between the melon and the superior rostrum surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent white depigmented patch or scar tissue at the very tip of the dorsal fin; multiple faint linear cutaneous rake marks visible across the mid-flank and dorsal cape.
other_distinctive_markers: High-contrast tri-color pigmentation pattern featuring a dark dorsal cape that dips ventrally below the dorsal fin.
